function makeShell(
   THREE, 
   def, 
   shellTexture, 
   parent, 
   texMap
): Object3D;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/primitives.ts:551

Translucent shell layer — Venus's haze atmosphere and the giant planets' rings get a secondary texture-mapped surface parented to the main mesh. A ringed body with no authored texture (Uranus, Neptune) falls back to ringStripFor's seeded dusty bands; radii default to Saturn's strip but def.ringInner/ringOuter pin the honest per-body span. Returns the created Object3D so the caller can register it as LOD detail.
